title: Presto non son pill forte
html_source:
From Don Giovanni I.ii:
Mi fa pieti Masetto… presto non son piu forte
“I feel said Masetto… now my strength is fading”
(note the error in the text: it should be “piu” rather than pill)

And “pietà” not “pieti”
